No authoritative source found either establishing or ruling out a central fingerprint store for Irish passports or identity documents. A secondary source (Irish Times, 16 Jan 2019) reports that Ireland secured a derogation from EU fingerprinting rules for passport cards, but no official statement was found. EUR-Lex (Reg. 2252/2004, 2019/1157) returned an HTTP 202 challenge and Oireachtas parliamentary questions returned HTTP 405 to automated fetches, so neither could be quoted. Fingerprints held for immigration or policing were not researched.
